final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vdd vss ibias
* main CS gain stage (scaled up 1.5x for more gm -> higher GBW and f3db)
M1   vout vin  vss vss nfet W=0.875 L=0.5 m=24
M2   vout vbp  vdd vdd pfet W=2.5   L=0.5 m=24
* 1/24 replica bias branch (sets vbp so that Vout_DC = V(vbp))
Mr   vbp  vref vss vss nfet W=0.875 L=0.5 m=1
Mrp  vbp  vbp  vdd vdd pfet W=2.5   L=0.5 m=1
* 0.75 V replica of input DC level
R1   vdd  vref 2.1e6
R2   vref vss  1.5e6
C1   vref vss  1p
C2   vbp  vdd  2p
* reference current sink
Mb   ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
.ends
